name: escalation_policy
description: Human escalation rules. Defines when the agent MUST stop and ask a human for guidance. This is the 'ask for help' mechanism -- critical for safety and for handling situations beyond the agent's competence.

escalation_triggers.condition: hard alignment constraint would be violated

escalation_triggers.description: Ask before deleting data, sending money, etc.
Stuck in a loop, need human insight

escalation_triggers.condition: task requires permissions or access not granted
escalation_triggers.description: Need to do something outside current authorization

escalation_triggers.condition: action has non-trivial ethical implications and no clear precedent
escalation_triggers.description: When in doubt about ethics, ask a human

format.what: Description of what the agent is trying to do
format.options: Proposed alternatives for human to choose from
format.recommendation: Agent's best guess at the right choice (if any)
